source: WLC via OSHB morphhb (same pin as strong-verb.json)
rules: Same OSHB slot as the cell (stem, conjugation, person/gender/number; participles absolute state; non-Qal participles r or s).
Bare verb only: no pronominal suffix; a prefixed ו, preposition or article is allowed and shown in "prefix" (wayyiqtol: the ו is part of the form).
Letters and vowels compared cluster by cluster (accents, meteg ignored; dagesh lene at word start ignored; full/defective ḥolem, shureq/qibbuṣ, ḥireq-yod normalised).
Root letters in the school form are wildcards; they must equal the Strong's headword consonants of the WLC word. Non-root letters must be identical.
Ketiv excluded; qere (inside notes) excluded; Aramaic excluded.

Strong page: roots with no guttural/weak letter first ("strong"), then roots with a guttural/ר/נ that keeps the same vowels ("guttural-or-nun"). Weak pages: the headword must belong to the page's class; roots with only that weakness ("pure") first.
Gray (shaded) weak cells: searched with the school's own page-1 strong form, restricted to roots of the page's class.

Hollow and Geminate pages only: the school's Piel/Pual/Hitpael columns hold Polel/Polal/Hithpolel forms, so OSHB stems o/m (Polel/Poel), O/M (Polal/Poal) and r (Hithpolel) count for those columns (see oshbStem).
Up to 5 examples, one per root first, unprefixed first, canonical order.
